title: Ubiquiti airFiber AF-5XHD 5Ghz 1Gbps+ Long Range PTP Backhaul Radio Link

items.h: Max. range*: 100+ km (Throughput and range values may vary depending on the environmental conditions)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Ubiquiti airFiber 5XHD is a premium 5GHz carrier-class Point-to-Point (PTP) wireless radio, engineered for high-throughput backhaul links in demanding network environments. Capable of delivering 1Gbps+ real TCP/IP throughput, the airFiber 5XHD is ideal for long-range connectivity, core network bridging, and video surveillance transmission.

Built with INVICTUS™ custom silicon and Advanced RF filtering, this radio ensures superior performance in congested environments. With GPS synchronization, the airFiber 5XHD supports co-location deployments, enhancing scalability in dense installations.


Key Features:

  • Frequency Range: 4.9 – 6.2 GHz (FCC dependent)

  • Throughput: Over 1 Gbps+ real TCP/IP

  • GPS Sync for co-location & network efficiency

  • Custom INVICTUS™ chip for high performance

  • Modulation: up to 1024QAM

  • Spectral Efficiency: up to 21.2 bps/Hz

  • IP67-rated ruggedized enclosure

  • Compatible with Ubiquiti airFiber X Antennas


Link Distance:

  • Maximum Line-of-Sight Distance: Up to 100+ km

  • Typical Reliable PTP Distance: 10–60 km (with appropriate antenna and clear LOS)
